method: Microsoft Excel 16 COM CalculateFullRebuild on temporary copies of both source XLSM. The engine is rebuilt from source inputs and versioned literal snapshots; no Excel output/cache is passed as an engine input. EXACT compares exact rational to the captured IEEE-754 rational; NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT means correctly represented values round to the same binary64; DISPLAY_MATCH is formula-format presentation only and does not assert exact numeric equality. No epsilon is used.
